crossRefs.note: Saul dressed David with his clothing. He put a helmet of bronze on his head, and he clad him with a coat of mail.

translations.web: He had a helmet of bronze on his head, and he wore a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of bronze.
translations.bsb: and he had a bronze helmet on his head. He wore a bronze coat of mail weighing five thousand shekels,
translations.kjv: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.
translations.asv: And he had a helmet of brass upon his head, and he was clad with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.
